name: Dime
long_description:
At Dime, we automate repetitive administrative work in healthcare clinics, including insurance coordination, referrals, referring-provider communication, scheduling, and patient communication. 

We integrate directly with RIS and EHR systems, creating true end-to-end automation rather than adding another software layer. Our HIPAA-compliant AI agents eliminate paperwork bottlenecks, reduce errors, and restore hours of clinical time - enabling care teams to focus on patients.
one_liner: Dime automates administrative busywork at healthcare clinics

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Ashish is a co-founder @ Dime. 

He's a passionate Detroiter (Go Lions!) excited about applying AI to help the American healthcare system operate efficiently. Before Dime, Ashish led the business operations and finance functions at a Series B Ghost Kitchen aggregator.  Before that, he spent four years in finance, first as an Investment Banker at Rothschild, and then as an Investor at TPG.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Co-Founder of dime, the factory operating system.

My roots in Detroit—the Motor City—fuel my passion for melding technology with manufacturing. Growing up with summers in factories and a family deeply embedded in the auto industry, from my dad's factory insights to my mom's work on control systems  for Chrysler, I was fascinated by how cars come to life.
